tokens.name: bitcoin-orange
tokens.usage: Satoshi Orange: the orange of the ₿ logo, named for Bitcoin's creator. The brand colour. Fills the දීප glyph in every full-colour logo and the ₿ coin. Use for large fills, icons, buttons and display type on black. Never for body text on white (2.3:1); on white use `orange-text`. Text on a bitcoin-orange fill is `on-orange`.

tokens.name: yaka-1
tokens.usage: Yaka mask gradient, stop 0%. The gradient runs bottom-left to top-right through yaka-1 to yaka-6. Reserve the gradient for the mask artwork and hero moments; never for text.

tokens.name: yaka-2
tokens.usage: Yaka mask gradient, stop 21%.

tokens.name: yaka-3
tokens.usage: Yaka mask gradient, stop 44%.

tokens.name: yaka-4
tokens.usage: Yaka mask gradient, stop 67%. Also usable alone as a warm secondary fill.

tokens.name: yaka-5
tokens.usage: Yaka mask gradient, stop 91%.

tokens.name: yaka-6
tokens.usage: Yaka mask gradient, stop 100% — the red tip of the flames. Usable as a small accent fill; not for body text (4.1:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Genesis Black: after the genesis block. The 'bitcoin' wordmark on light grounds and the brand's dark ground in artwork and print. #000001, one step off pure black.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Whitepaper White: after the 2008 Bitcoin whitepaper. The 'bitcoin' wordmark on dark grounds and the brand's light ground in artwork and print. #FFFFFE, one step off pure white.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Cold Storage Charcoal: after offline wallets. Ground for the Lightning card and printed product. White text and the gradient Yaka. Not an app surface: the app uses `surface-card`.

tokens.name: warm-white
tokens.usage: Paper Wallet Cream: after keys printed on paper. Ground for decks and documents (the Journey deck). `lanka-maroon` headlines and `brand-black` text.

tokens.name: lanka-maroon
tokens.usage: Perahera Maroon: the deep red of the Esala Perahera's festival cloth and the lion flag's field. Heritage pattern colour (Sri Lanka flag maroon), and the headline colour on `warm-white` / white in decks and documents (9.0:1). White text on it reads 9.0:1.

tokens.name: lanka-teal
tokens.usage: Sinharaja Green: the dark canopy of the Sinharaja rainforest. Heritage pattern colour (Sri Lanka flag green). Pattern tiles; white text on it reads 8.8:1.

tokens.name: lanka-saffron
tokens.usage: Vesak Gold: the glow of Vesak lanterns. Heritage pattern colour (Sri Lanka flag saffron). Pattern tiles; black text only (12.7:1).

tokens.name: lanka-orange
tokens.usage: Thambili Orange: the husk of the king coconut. Heritage pattern colour (Sri Lanka flag orange). Pattern tiles only, never next to bitcoin-orange in the same block — the two are close but not the same.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `bitcoin-orange` fill (9.2:1). Never white on orange for text — it fails contrast.

tokens.name: orange-50
tokens.usage: Orange scale, lightest. Quiet fills behind orange-led content.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Orange scale, for interface states, charts and illustration.

tokens.name: orange-200
tokens.usage: Orange scale, for interface states, charts and illustration.

tokens.name: orange-300
tokens.usage: Orange scale, for interface states, charts and illustration.

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Orange scale, for interface states, charts and illustration.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Orange scale base: the same value as `bitcoin-orange`. Use `bitcoin-orange` for anything that stands for the brand.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Orange scale. Fails body-text contrast on white (4.1:1).

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Orange scale. Orange text on white (6.2:1); close to `orange-text`.

tokens.name: orange-800
tokens.usage: Orange scale, for interface states, charts and illustration.

tokens.name: orange-900
tokens.usage: Orange scale, for interface states, charts and illustration.

tokens.name: slate-100

tokens.name: slate-200
tokens.usage: Slate greys from the Bitcoin Deepa app designs. Light dividers and disabled fills.

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Slate greys from the Bitcoin Deepa app designs. Dark muted text.

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Slate greys from the Bitcoin Deepa app designs. Light muted text on cards.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Slate greys from the Bitcoin Deepa app designs. Light tab labels; muted text on the light screen.

tokens.name: slate-700

tokens.usage: Slate greys from the Bitcoin Deepa app designs. Inverse chips and secondary buttons, both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App and website screen background behind cards. Light theme carries the black logo, dark the white one.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, sheets and the search field.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tab bar and segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Selected filter chips and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse` (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, secondary text on cards (4.8:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tab-bar labels and muted text on the screen background.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between list rows. Never a button border.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and selected states: Satoshi Orange in both themes, solid fill, no stroke.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`. Always black (9.2:1).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill.

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: Text on a disabled button.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Links, @handles, prices and orange text (6.2:1 on white cards, 7.2:1 on dark cards). The app mock-ups' #FA7119 reads only 2.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. Never a resting button border.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Received sats, confirmed payments, completed tasks (5.3:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, needs attention. Dark warning is Vesak Gold (5.9:1 light, 9.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sent sats, failed payments, errors (4.6:1 light, 5.0:1 dark). The app mock-ups' light red #F45A5A reads only 3.3:1 on white.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headlines only. Bold italic echoes the slant of the 'bitcoin' wordmark.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Bitcoin Deepa brings Bitcoin to the island.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Running text, forms and UI copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels, captions, units. Uppercase allowed here only.

styles.name: slogan
styles.usage: The slogan when set live. The artwork uses Nunito Sans Condensed Italic; prefer the Slogan PNG assets where possible.

styles.name: si-body
styles.usage: Sinhala running text. Needs more line height than Latin for vowel signs.

styles.name: si-heading
styles.usage: Sinhala headings. The දීප in the logo is custom lettering — never retype it in a font.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The heritage pattern's rounded tiles (about one-sixth of the tile side). Buttons and cards echo it: buttons are rounded squares, never pills.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Coin badges like the ₿ disc, status pills.
